next.reason: 1985: '[ AT END imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT AT END imperative-statement-2 ]'; 2023: 'zero or more of the enclosed alternatives may be specified, each at most once, in any order'. 2023 READ format accepts NOT AT END/NOT INVALID KEY before AT END/INVALID KEY, which 1985 refused. It also adds PREVIOUS, LOCK, retry and KEY phrases.
